Title: Add-on and withdrawal effect of pravastatin on proteinuria in hypertensive patients treated with AT1 receptor blockers
Author: Lee, Lin, Tsai, and Chang
Comment: Arm means and SDs were reported in mg/24 hours and converted to g/24 h by multiplying by 0.001: placebo 1262 ± 557 mg/24 h = 1.262 ± 0.557 g/24 h; pravastatin 559 ± 251 mg/24 h = 0.559 ± 0.251 g/24 h. M_diff was computed as group 2 (pravastatin) minus group 1 (placebo): 0.559 − 1.262 = −0.703 g/24 h. The paper’s P < 0.0001 in this section is explicitly for the within-pravastatin change from baseline, not necessarily the direct between-arm endpoint comparison, so p_value was left null. The paper analyzed log-transformed proteinuria inferentially because the raw outcome was skewed.
